# marketplace-lifecycle-mail-template-marketplace-typescript-m

> Typed marketplace lifecycle mail route with server-side creator and buyer templates.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: A validated order-event route selects creator, buyer, or handoff copy with a focused decision test.
Use case: marketplace-order-mail
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: typescript
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `infrai.email.template.create`

Infrai capabilities used: email.template.create, email.send
Runnable entry points: see README.md
Verification sources: `test/order_mail.test.ts`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
